description.zh-CN: 模型服务就绪后，统一入口自动做一次轻量验证（连通、对话、思考分离、工具调用、JSON、图片、速度），约占用一分钟的模型时间。first-launch：同一模型、运行时和配置第一次启动时验证；always：每次启动都验证；off：只在手动点击时验证。验证不会和压测同时进行。
description.en-US: When a model service is ready, the entry runs one light qualification (reachability, chat, reasoning split, tool call, JSON, image, speed), about a minute of model time. first-launch: the first launch of a model, runtime and configuration; always: every launch; off: only when you press the button. A qualification never overlaps a benchmark.
